# Security Requirements Quality Checklist: Unified Commerce Backend

**Purpose**: Assess whether identity, authentication, authorization, and
secret-protection requirements are complete, clear, consistent, and testable.
**Created**: 2026-10-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist`
command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality
review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the
requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and
satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is
complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are authentication requirements defined for every customer, administrator, service, and public resource boundary? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 - Does the specification explicitly state that customer identity is derived from the authenticated JWT rather than from a caller-supplied customer identifier? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are the only first-release roles explicitly defined as `CUSTOMER` and `ADMIN`, including which operations each role may perform? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015–FR-017]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is password protection specified as hashing with a named minimum security property, while keeping raw passwords out of logs and persisted records? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are token expiry, invalid-token, missing-token, and token-revocation expectations documented? [Gap, Spec §FR-001–FR-002]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are service-to-service credentials and background-operation permissions defined separately from customer JWT permissions? [Completeness, Constitution §Platform Constraints]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 - Is “unauthorized access” defined with distinct expected outcomes for missing authentication, invalid authentication, insufficient role, and ownership failure? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the phrase “clear correction message” constrained so that security failures do not disclose whether protected records exist? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 - Are the customer-owned resources and the administrator's allowed cross-customer lookup scope enumerated without relying on “authorized” as an undefined term? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002, FR-017]
- [ ] CHK010 - Are JWT claims, issuer/signing-key expectations, and the trust boundary for token validation documented sufficiently to make authentication requirements unambiguous? [Gap, Plan §Technical Context]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 - Do the requirements consistently use JWT-derived identity across profiles, carts, orders, payments, and refunds? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001–FR-014]
- [ ] CHK012 - Do the stated `CUSTOMER` and `ADMIN` roles align with every acceptance scenario that refers to an “authorized administrator” or “person without administrator authority”? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 4]
- [ ] CHK013 - Are requirements consistent about whether administrators may act on behalf of customers or only review and operate business records? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-015–FR-017]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK014 - Can every authentication and authorization requirement be evaluated with an objective expected outcome and an explicit actor/role? [Measurability, Spec §FR-001–FR-002, FR-015–FR-017]
- [ ] CHK015 - Are negative security outcomes required to leave protected business data unchanged, not only to return a denial? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 4]
- [ ] CHK016 - Are password, token, and sensitive payment-data handling requirements measurable in both persisted data and operational logs? [Measurability, Constitution §III]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK017 - Is “least privilege” translated into concrete permissions for the single ADMIN role and the service/background actor? [Ambiguity, Constitution §III]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is the treatment of compromised, expired, or rotated signing secrets specified, or is the omission intentionally out of scope? [Gap, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK019 - Are account lockout, repeated-login failure, and credential-recovery requirements explicitly included or excluded? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]

## Notes

- All newly generated items intentionally remain unchecked for reviewer-owned assessment.
- User-specified security focus incorporated: JWT-derived customer identity,
  `CUSTOMER`/`ADMIN` roles, and hashed passwords.
- Vague terms explicitly flagged include “authorized,” “clear,” and “least
  privilege.”
